title: Page
description: page.json at page format version 3: one pull request as the data a reader draws. docs/page-data.md gives the meaning and the rendering rules. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

schema.description: The page format version. This file describes version 3 only.

sections.description: The fixed sections, in display order.

elements.description: Every element a view draws, by element id, such as fn:pkg.mod.name or mod:pkg.mod.

views.description: The views that apply, in section order, then lens order.

files.description: Every changed file, with its hunks.

comments.description: Comments from GitHub: inline review comments, review bodies, and issue comments.

notes.description: Reader notes the page seeds. Producers write an empty array. Readers keep notes elsewhere, under meta.key.

facets.description: Named ways to look at part of the change. Absent when the change has none.

parts.description: Where the changed lines go: the parts of the change in display order. Every changed line is in exactly one part, so the parts sum to meta.adds plus meta.dels. Absent on pages from before parts.

PageKind.title: PageKind
PageKind.description: What the page shows. Only pull requests exist.

Side.title: Side
Side.description: One side of the change: base is the merge base, head is the PR's head commit.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: What the change does to an element. This set can grow without a version bump. Readers treat a status they do not know as "changed".

LineRange.title: LineRange
LineRange.description: First and last line, 1-based and inclusive.

DiffOp.title: DiffOp
DiffOp.description: A diff line's operation, one character: a space for an unchanged line, + for an added line, - for a removed line. A pattern rather than an enum, because code generators cannot name these values.

DiffLine.title: DiffLine
DiffLine.description: One diff line: [base line or null, head line or null, op, text without the op character]. Code generators that do not read prefixItems see an array of four values.

prefixItems.description: Line number at the base, or null for an added line.
Line number at the head, or null for a removed line.

GitRef.title: GitRef
GitRef.description: A branch name and a commit.

sha.description: The full commit id. For the base, the merge base.

PrState.title: PrState
PrState.description: The PR's state on GitHub, in lower case.

Meta.title: Meta
Meta.description: The pull request the page shows.

key.description: The key under which a reader keeps its notes on this page.

language.description: The language provider that read the repo, such as python or rust, or none. Open set.

issues.description: Numbers of the issues the PR closes.

generated.description: When collect built the page, as an ISO 8601 time.

Section.title: Section
Section.description: One fixed section of the page, such as overview or behavior.

id.description: The section id: overview, context, map, behavior, responsibilities, contracts, surroundings, or code. Treat it as an open set.

ic.description: An icon name, a presentation hint that each reader maps to its own icons. Open set.

empty.description: The default line for a section with no view.

views.description: Ids of the section's views, in order. Empty when the section collapses.

reason.description: Why the section has no view, or null when it has views.

ViewState.title: ViewState
ViewState.description: Whether a view found something. assemble keeps only views that apply. This set can grow without a version bump. Readers treat a state they do not know as "na".

Oneliner.title: Oneliner
Oneliner.description: A fact too small for a view, listed in the overview. It opens an element, or a file at a line.

file.description: A repo path to open in the code view.

line.description: The line to open the file at.

View.title: View
View.description: One view of the change, drawn as a list of blocks.

id.description: The view id, unique on the page.

sec.description: The id of the section the view belongs to.

ic.description: An icon name, a presentation hint that each reader maps to its own icons. Open set.

metric.description: A short count line, such as "2 functions · 6 sites changed". May be empty.

narration.description: The agent's caption, plain text with `code` spans, or null.

blocks.description: What the view draws, in order.

oneliners.description: Small facts that the overview lists under "Smaller changes".

ElementRef.title: ElementRef
ElementRef.description: Where an element lives in one file, on each side.

base.description: Lines at the base, or null when the base lacks the element.

head.description: Lines at the head, or null when the head lacks the element.

file.description: True when the element is the whole file, such as a module. Such a ref has no src.

src.description: The element's own unified diff, never cut short.

Element.title: Element
Element.description: Anything a view draws that maps to code or to a fact.

k.description: Its kind and home, such as "function · dblect.sql.window_ties".

refs.description: Where the element lives. Empty for elements that are not code.

url.description: The element's page on GitHub, for PRs, issues, docs, people, and commits.

h.description: A hash of the element's own changed lines, without line numbers, so that it survives a push that only shifts the code. Absent for unchanged elements.

FileKind.title: FileKind
FileKind.description: The line-accounting kind of a path. This set can grow without a version bump. Readers treat a kind they do not know as "other".

GeneratedBy.title: GeneratedBy
GeneratedBy.description: Why a file of kind generated is generated: "gitattributes" (.gitattributes marks it linguist-generated), "header" (its header says so), or "path" (its path matches a generated pattern). A plain string, so a reader shows a reason it does not know as it is.

VendoredBy.title: VendoredBy
VendoredBy.description: Why a file of kind vendored is vendored: "gitattributes" (.gitattributes marks it linguist-vendored), "path" (under vendor/, third_party/, or node_modules/), "testdata" (not code, under fixtures/, testdata/, or __snapshots__/), or "narration" (the agent marked it copied). A plain string, so a reader shows a reason it does not know as it is.

PartKind.title: PartKind
PartKind.description: What a part holds. new: new code. existing: changes to files that existed at the merge base. test, generated, vendored, docs (docs and build files). Open set.

Part.title: Part
Part.description: One part of the change, for the overview's line table.

id.description: Unique on the page. A new part is new:<package or module>. The others are existing, test, generated, vendored, and docs.

label.description: The part's name: the agent's, else the package or module names.

verdict.description: How much review it needs: read, skim, or skip. Open set.

lines.description: The changed lines that count in this part.

files.description: The files with lines in this part, and how many. A file can be in two parts, such as a source file with inline tests.

modules.description: The modules of a new part.

els.description: Sorted element ids whose code lies in this part. The part facet uses them.

FileStatus.title: FileStatus
FileStatus.description: Set for a new or a deleted file. A modified or renamed file has no status.

Hunk.title: Hunk
Hunk.description: One hunk of a file's diff.

FileText.title: FileText
FileText.description: The whole text of a file on each side.

base.description: The text at the base, or null when the file is new.

head.description: The text at the head, or null when the file is deleted.

Whole.title: Whole
Whole.description: Whether the file ships its whole text.

ok.description: True when text holds the whole file.

why.description: Why the whole file is not there, when ok is false.

path.description: The repo path at the head.

old.description: The repo path at the base. It differs from path for a rename.

binary.description: True for a binary file. It has no hunks.

vendored_note.description: The agent's reason, when it marked the file copied.

lines_by_kind.description: Changed lines of this file that count under another kind, such as the test code inside a source file (Rust's #[cfg(test)] mod). Maps a kind to its added and deleted lines. The rest of add and del count under the file's own kind. Absent when every line counts under it.

CommentKind.title: CommentKind
CommentKind.description: Where on GitHub a comment was left. This set can grow without a version bump. Readers treat a kind they do not know as "issue".

at.description: When it was left, as an ISO 8601 time.

body.description: The Markdown body, cut to a few thousand characters.

reply_to.description: The id of the comment it answers, or null.

path.description: The file it anchors to, or null.

side.description: The side of its line, or null.

line.description: The line it anchors to, carried to the head when outdated, or null.

start.description: The first line of a multi-line comment, or null.

outdated.description: True when it was left on code that later changed.

state.description: A review's state from GitHub, such as APPROVED or COMMENTED, or null. Open set.

FacetOption.title: FacetOption
FacetOption.description: One option of a facet: a set of element ids.

note.description: One line that says what the set holds.

els.description: Sorted element ids. An id may name an element that no view draws.

Facet.title: Facet
Facet.description: A named way to look at part of the change across the whole page.

id.description: Unique on the page, such as story or focus. Open set.

options.description: The facet's options, in display order.

Block.title: Block
Block.description: One block of a view, tagged by type. A reader that meets a type it does not know should say the block is in the browser page, and draw the rest. The variants sit inline, so that code generators such as typify make an internally tagged enum.

oneOf.title: NarrationBlock
oneOf.description: The agent's overview text. assemble puts it first in the overview.

note.description: A muted line under the block.

oneOf.title: SummaryBlock
oneOf.description: One tile per section that shows. assemble builds it for the overview.

oneOf.title: TableBlock
oneOf.description: A table. It can rank, group, and fold its rows.

rows.description: The rows, in display order: key, then normal, then minor.

note.description: A muted line under the block.

src.description: Where the facts come from, shown next to the title.

el.description: The element the whole table is about.

docs.description: True for the context view's table of documents.

groups.description: The row groups, in display order.

oneOf.title: SvgBlock
oneOf.description: A diagram laid out at build time. The jobs canvas is an svg block whose root has data-jobs.

hot.description: SVG node id to element id. A click on that node opens the element.

note.description: A muted line under the block.

brief.description: Lines that describe the diagram in brief.md. Readers ignore them.

oneOf.title: LanesBlock
oneOf.description: Lanes of cards before and after the change. No lens writes it now. The viewer still draws it.

note.description: A muted line under the block.

oneOf.title: GraphBlock
oneOf.description: A Mermaid diagram that the browser lays out. No lens writes it now. The viewer still draws it.

note.description: A muted line under the block.

src.description: Where the facts come from, shown next to the title.

oneOf.title: CodeBlock
oneOf.description: Every file in the page's files: hunks open, unchanged runs folded.

oneOf.title: DiscussionBlock
oneOf.description: Comments with no file, such as review bodies and issue comments.

SummaryItem.title: SummaryItem
SummaryItem.description: One tile of the overview summary. It opens its view.

view.description: The id of the view it opens.

metric.description: The count lines of the section's views. May be empty.

text.description: One sentence, plain text with `code` spans.

ColumnKind.title: ColumnKind
ColumnKind.description: How a column draws its cells. A column without kind draws plain text. text: plain text with `code` spans. mono: monospace. num: a number. status: a status word. bar: a number with a bar. refs: a list of links. This set can grow without a version bump. Readers draw a column of a kind they do not know as "text".

key.description: The key of this column's cell in each row's cells.

CellLink.title: CellLink
CellLink.description: A cell or a list entry as an object. With el, it opens that element. With file, it opens that file in the code view, at line when given. With href, it is a link. With facet, it applies that facet option. With none of these, it is plain text.

file.description: A repo path to open in the code view.

line.description: The line to open the file at.

facet.description: A facet option to apply, as <facet id>.<option id>, such as part.existing.

CellListItem.title: CellListItem
CellListItem.description: One entry of a list cell.

Cell.title: Cell
Cell.description: One table cell: a string, a number, an object, or a list of entries (for refs columns).

Row.title: Row
Row.description: One table row. Producers write rows in display order.

cells.description: Cells by column key. A missing key is an empty cell.

el.description: The element the row opens, or null.

side.description: Narrows el to one side, or null.

view.description: A view the row opens when it has no el.

dim.description: True to draw the row muted.

rank.description: key: a row to read first. minor: noise that folds. Absent, or any other value, means a normal row. Open set.

why.description: The reason for the rank, in a few plain words. A reader may show it as a tooltip.

group.description: The id of a group in the table's groups. An id that groups does not list means no group.

TableGroup.title: TableGroup
TableGroup.description: A section of a table's rows, with a header the reader can open and close.

summary.description: One line of plain text with `code` spans for the header.

open.description: Whether the group starts open. Producers set false for a group of minor rows only.

Fold.title: Fold
Fold.description: How a table folds. Minor rows fold with or without it.

show.description: How many rows that are not minor each group shows before it folds the rest. Absent: all of them.

label.description: A name for the minor rows, for the control that unfolds them.

ChipMove.title: ChipMove
ChipMove.description: Whether a job moves out of its card or into it.

LaneChip.title: LaneChip
LaneChip.description: A job on a lane card.

LaneCard.title: LaneCard
LaneCard.description: A card on a lane, such as a class or a module.

note.description: Plain text with `code` spans under the label.

Lane.title: Lane
Lane.description: One lane, such as a package, with its cards.

Mermaid.title: Mermaid
Mermaid.description: Mermaid source: one diagram, or one per side.

Tour.title: Tour
Tour.description: The walk through the change: chapters of stops, each stop one idea with the code that carries it. A reader that draws it makes it the main view, and keeps the sections as the reference. Absent on pages from before the tour.

narrated.description: True when the agent wrote the tour's text. False: titles are defaults made from element names, and Before, Now, and Watch are absent.

summary.description: What the change does, in at most 40 words. Plain text with `code` spans.

flags.description: At most three facts that change how to read the PR.

below.description: The changed lines in no stop, by part: tests that join no stop, docs, generated and vendored files.

map.description: The changed files by package, for a code map beside the tour.

TourFlag.title: TourFlag
TourFlag.description: A fact that changes how to read the PR.

kind.description: warn or info. Open set: a reader draws a kind it does not know as info.

text.description: At most two sentences, plain text with `code` spans.

ref.description: What the flag points at: comment:<kind>:<id>, an element id, or view:<id>.

TourChapter.title: TourChapter
TourChapter.description: One chapter: a read part of the change, or the whole change when it fits in one.

id.description: Unique on the page, a slug such as perch-changescape.

h.description: A hash of the hashes of its stops. The element chapter:<id> carries the same hash.

intro.description: Two or three sentences: what the part is for, what it gives the parts above it, and the terms its first stop uses.

parts.description: The ids of the parts in `parts` that the chapter covers.

sections.description: Optional. Named groups of consecutive stops, for a long chapter. Each stop id is in at most one section. A reader that ignores sections draws the stops as one list.

TourSection.title: TourSection
TourSection.description: A named group of consecutive stops inside one chapter.

TourLines.title: TourLines
TourLines.description: Changed lines to read and to skim.

TourSpine.title: TourSpine
TourSpine.description: The one picture that orients a chapter, before its first stop: a call diagram (a picture of kind seq) of the chapter's main paths, from where a run starts to its changed functions, with only the path steps and the changed calls.

TourStop.title: TourStop
TourStop.description: One stop: one idea with the code that carries it.

id.description: Unique on the page, a slug made from element or file names.

h.description: A hash of the changed lines in its hunk pictures, without line numbers. The element stop:<id> carries the same hash.

title.description: A claim of at most 12 words, plain text with `code` spans.

before.description: One sentence: what the code did at the base. Absent for new code.

now.description: One sentence: what the code does now.

watch.description: One sentence that points at a fact or a review comment. Always with watch_ref.

watch_ref.description: What watch points at: comment:<kind>:<id> (kind inline, review, or issue), an element id, or view:<id>.

verdict.description: read or skim. Open set. Absent: use the verdict of the stop's part.

els.description: The elements whose code the stop holds, in file order.

pictures.description: What the stop shows, in order. At least one.

relies.description: Unchanged code that the stop's lines depend on.

asides.description: Context that matters at this stop.

lines.description: The changed lines the stop holds.

files.description: The changed lines the stop holds, by file and part.

TourFileLines.title: TourFileLines
TourFileLines.description: Changed lines of one file, in one part.

path.description: The repo path at the head, as in files.

part.description: The id of the part the lines count in.

TourPicture.title: TourPicture
TourPicture.description: One picture of a stop. kind hunk: windows of one file in files. kind seq: a call diagram laid out at build time, drawn like an svg block (svg, hot, title, note). Open set: a reader skips a kind it does not know.

file.description: For hunk: the repo path at the head, as in files.

windows.description: For hunk: the parts of the file to show, in file order.

svg.description: For seq: the SVG markup of a sequence diagram, as in an svg block.

hot.description: For seq: SVG node id to element id, as in an svg block. A click on that node opens the element.

title.description: For seq: a default heading, from the names where the path starts and ends.

note.description: For seq: a muted line under the diagram, its legend.

caption.description: One sentence over the picture, from the narration. A reader shows it in place of title.

TourWindow.title: TourWindow
TourWindow.description: Lines of one file, like a diff hunk header: a base range and a head range. A window holds every diff row inside its ranges, so a head window holds the lines removed inside it. The reader folds long unchanged runs.

base.description: Lines at the base, or null when the window only adds lines.

head.description: Lines at the head, or null when the window only removes lines.

TourRely.title: TourRely
TourRely.description: Unchanged code that a stop's lines call, extend, or match on.

why.description: Why the stop relies on it: matches, implements, or calls. An open set. A reader shows an unknown value as calls.

sig.description: The signature line, or an empty string.

doc.description: The doc comment, or an empty string.

what.description: One sentence: the contract the new lines rely on. Absent until the narration writes it.

code.title: TourRelyCode
code.description: Where the code is at the head.

TourAside.title: TourAside
TourAside.description: Context that matters at one stop, such as an open PR on the same files.

view.description: The view the context comes from.

rows.description: Element ids of the rows of that view.

TourBand.title: TourBand
TourBand.description: Changed lines of one part that are in no stop.

TourEnding.title: TourEnding
TourEnding.description: Where you stand: what to check before deciding, and what to do next.

TourCheck.title: TourCheck
TourCheck.description: A question to settle before deciding, with a one-line answer. The narration writes some, and the tools add context that attached to no stop.

view.description: The view the context comes from. Present on the checks that the tools add.

rows.description: Element ids of the rows of that view.

TourAction.title: TourAction
TourAction.description: Something to do after the tour.

TourMapPackage.title: TourMapPackage
TourMapPackage.description: One package and its changed files.

HotLabel.title: HotLabel
HotLabel.description: [element id, status] for a node label.
